module: Manages the career "leagues": groups of missions (and drift spots) attached to a skill, loaded from the /gameplay/**/*.leagues.json files on career activation. Computes whether a league is unlocked (conditions leagueStars, branchLevel, skillStars, branchStars, inDevelopment), the stars obtained/available, the display order, and checks the consistency of the missions (a single league, skill, showInCareer).
notes: The leagues are loaded by loadLeagues in onCareerActive(true); getLeagueById/getLeagueOfMission fail if called before (leaguesById is nil).
The unlock status is cached (league._unlocked); clearLeagueUnlockCache resets it as well as the per-skill star cache.
isLeagueUnlocked also writes condition.met/progress/label on the league's conditions and league.unlockLabels.
getLeaguesForUnlockChange unlocks the NEW_TERRITORY achievement if at least one league goes from locked to unlocked.
An 'inDevelopment' league gets unlock = {{type='inDevelopment'}} and an empty mission list.
Probable inconsistency: checkStartConditionLeague tests table.getn(lMap) > 1 on a keyed table (always 0), so the error 'several leagues in startCondition' never triggers.

getLeagueById.desc: Returns the league with the given id (raw table, not formatted).

getLeagueOfMission.desc: Returns the league that contains the given mission.

clearLeagueUnlockCache.desc: Clears each league's unlock cache and the per-skill star cache.

getSimpleUnlockedStatus.desc: Clears the cache then returns a table league id -> unlocked (boolean) for all leagues.

isLeagueUnlocked.desc: Evaluates (with cache) a league's unlock conditions; without conditions it is unlocked.

returns.desc: true if all conditions are met (false if the league does not exist).

formatLeague.desc: Deep copy of a league enriched for the UI: totalStarsAvailable, totalStarsObtained (missions and drift objectives), icon and accentColor of the skill ('badgeRoundStar' if certification).

getLeaguesForProgressBranchPage.desc: Lists the formatted leagues of a branch (and of its sub-skills unless ignoreSubSkills), sorted by _order. Without branchId, all leagues.

ignoreSubSkills.desc: If true, only keeps the leagues of the skill itself.

getLeaguesForUnlockChange.desc: Compares two unlock statuses and returns the newly unlocked leagues (formatted, sorted); unlocks the NEW_TERRITORY achievement if there are any.

getNoLeague.desc: Obsolete: logs the error 'Deprecated' and does nothing.

getLeaguesForMission.desc: Lists the formatted (sorted) leagues that contain the given mission.

addLeagueSortOrder.desc: Computes league._order: grouped by skill, sorted by required stars then file order, unlocked 'highlightIfUnlocked' leagues first, then skill order (career_branches.getOrder).

onCareerActive.desc: Hook: when the career becomes active, loads the leagues from the *.leagues.json files in /gameplay/.

getStarsForSkills.desc: Sum of the default stars available and unlocked for all missions whose careerSetup.skill is in the given table.

getStarsForSkill.desc: Shortcut for getStarsForSkills for a single skill.

getStartConditionLeagueId.desc: Fills map[leagueId] = true for each 'league' condition found in a startCondition (recursive on cond.nested).

checkMission.desc: Checks a mission's configuration against the leagues (startCondition consistent with the league, careerSetup.skill equal to the league's skill, showInCareer true) and logs 'E' errors.
